class.name: IfcPolyLoop
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A poly loop is a loop with straight edges bounding a planar region in space. A poly loop is a loop of genus 1 where the loop is represented by an ordered coplanar collection of points forming the vertices of the loop. The loop is composed of straight line segments joining a point in the collection to the succeeding point in the collection. The closing segment

members.member: List of points defining the loop. There are no repeated points in the list.
